full_judgment: 2. Facts of the case as disclosed in the application are that deceased Kudrut Ali, the predecessor of the present petitioners, and opposite-party Nos. 19 to 24 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 72 of 1975 in the First Court of Munsif, Kushtia for declaration of title in respect of the suit land. The defendant opposite party Nos. 2, 3, 4, 5, 13, 15, 16 and 19 contested the suit by filing two separate written statements denying the material allegations made in the plaint. The learned Munsif by a judgment dated 10.4.84 dismissed the above suit. Being aggrieved the plaintiffs preferred Title Appeal No. 103 of 1984 in the Court of the District Judge, Kushtia. Ultimately the appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, who, by his judgment dated 23.3.86, allowed the appeal, set aside the judgment and decree of the learned Munsif and sent the case back on remand for fresh trial with certain observations for imp leading Khukiran Nessa and Halima Khatun in the suit and, also for taking steps as per law as regards death of plaintiff No. 2 Kudrut Ali. After remand the case was transferred to the court of Munsif, Mirpur Upazilia and the above Title Suit was re-numbered as Title Suit 75 of 1986.
